firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently finished drinking a delicious cup of tea is the first start player.
clarifications: Play moves clockwise from the start player within each round.
For later rounds, the player with the fewest sugar cubes becomes the new start player. If tied, use the tied player closest to the current start player in clockwise order.
